sources.entry: admidio - User management system for websites of organizations and groups. The system has a flexible role model so that it’s possible to reflect the structure and permissions of your organization. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Admidio is a free, self-hosted membership management system for clubs, associations, and organizations, with a flexible role model, permissions, and modules for events, inventory, messaging, forums, and files.
summary.what_it_does: Admidio manages members, groups, and roles so that the permission structure can mirror an organization's hierarchy. It supports customizable member profile fields, relationships between members (such as spouses or parents and children), and member lists that can be filtered, sorted, and exported. Additional modules cover event management with registrations and room scheduling, online registration requests, inventory lending with borrowing history, and messaging or HTML email to members, roles, or groups. It also includes announcements, a discussion forum, photo galleries with e-cards, and document/file management with role-based access. The README says it is a Progressive Web App that can be installed on mobile and desktop, and it can be integrated into an existing website or run standalone.
use_cases: organize members into roles and groups
send email newsletters to member groups
share documents and photos within an organization
how_to_run: Install PHP 8.2 or higher and a MariaDB 10+, MySQL 5.0+, or PostgreSQL 11+ database
Follow the online installation instructions on the Admidio site

Or run the prebuilt image: docker run --detach -it --name "Admidio" -p 8080:8080 -v "Admidio-files:/opt/app-root/src/adm_my_files" -e ADMIDIO_DB_HOST=... admidio/admidio:latest (see README for full command)
Access index.php in the Admidio folder to run updates after replacing files
notable: Flexible role model that reflects organizational structure and permissions
Covers membership, events, inventory, forum, galleries, and files in one system
Available as a Progressive Web App
caveats: Requires a PHP web server and a SQL database; not a single-binary install
Developed and maintained by volunteers, per the README
Custom themes need care during updates, since the README's update steps assume no custom themes
keywords: run membership system on own server
